# `Q-25-4` — Component binds to no element

> A component's `bind` selector (`#id` or `.class`) matches no Div or Span on the page, so the component was not shipped with it.

## What this means

Each component binds to the elements its `bind` selects: `#id` for the
one Div or Span with that id, `.class` for every Div or Span with that
class. The default is `#<name>`. When nothing on the page matches, there
is nothing to mount, so Quarto warns and leaves the component out of the
page.

## Why this happens

- The element is missing, or its id or class is spelled differently.
- `bind:` was omitted and no element has the component's name as its id.
- The element is not a Div or Span (a heading or a code block cannot host
  a component).
- The id was rewritten: a heading inside a `:::` div gets its own section
  id, for example, and ids on other block kinds do not count.

## How to fix

Give the element the id or class (`::: {#counter}` ... `:::` for a block,
`[text]{.sparkline}` for an inline), or set `bind:` to the selector it
already has.

## Related

- The components guide (`docs/guides/authoring/components.qmd`) describes
  the `components:` key, the element contract and the runtime.
